newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle slow at $107/dressed - private.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle slow at $107/dressed - private.

text.p: Nebraska feedlot cattle near midday Wednesday sold in light volume at $107.00 per cwt on a dressed basis, market sources said.
About 5,000 head sold, with the bulk coming from the central part of the state, they said. Further asking levels were at $108.00/dressed.
Week to date sales were pegged near 65,000 head. Showlists this week were estimated near 80,000 head.
Feedlot operators were bracing for more cold and blizzard conditions Thursday, especially in the northeastern area where winter death loss was estimated at three to five percent.
